message.content: On June 24, 2026, at 14:00, LiHua sends a video to the group chat. According to the text, the content of the message is "Just sent a video of me playing the intro to "Stairway to Heaven."" This indicates that LiHua shares a video of himself performing the opening notes of the iconic rock song "Stairway to Heaven" by the band Led Zeppelin.
